items.title: Being a regular sequence in the fibre is an open condition
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a finite type map with Cohen-Macaulay equidimensional fibres of dimension d, the set of points where a fixed sequence is regular in the fibre is open (statement lines 33478-33492). The proof does not work with the regularity condition directly: it converts regularity at a point into a numerical inequality involving the relative dimension, spreads that inequality to a neighbourhood using upper semicontinuity of the dimension function, and recovers regularity by the Cohen-Macaulay criterion (proof lines 33494-33521). Replacing regularity by a semicontinuous numerical condition is the step that makes openness visible. H2.
